title: token-level-observability: add token-level cost/latency dashboards and alert tuning
author: Rina Patel
description: Context: product teams need per-token visibility into cost and latency to debug regressions and tune batching/caching. This PR implements token-level metrics emission, Grafana dashboards for token-level cost and latency breakdowns, and tuned alert rules for token-latency and cost anomalies. Changes include runtime metric hooks, tagging by model/request/route, dashboard JSON, alert rules, docs/runbook, and tests. Checklist: 1) Emit token-level metrics with stable tag set; 2) Add Grafana dashboards with template variables for model/route/region; 3) Add Prometheus alert rules for token-latency p95 and token-cost anomaly detection; 4) Add integration tests and e2e metrics check; 5) Run performance microbenchmarks to validate no meaningful CPU regression. Testing: unit + integration + e2e metrics checks all passed in CI. Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout by traffic tier (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and monitor cost/regression dashboards for 48h between steps. Backwards compatibility: metrics are additive and default tags fall back to previous keys. Related: ENG-5123 (dashboards), ENG-5132 (alert tuning).
